name: limits
title: Limits
description: A fixture for pilot-ext-host's limits: commands that allocate past Pilot's memory stop, and one that never commits in time.
author: banozz

commands.name: hog
commands.title: Use too much memory
commands.description: Fills 64 MiB buffers up to 768 MiB, then holds them in a busy loop for 3 s before it lists anything.

commands.name: grow
commands.title: Grow when pressed
commands.description: Lists one row whose action fills 64 MiB buffers up to 768 MiB, then holds them for 3 s: the memory stop on an open view.

commands.name: silent
commands.title: Answer too late
commands.description: Spins for 3 s in a synchronous loop before its first commit, past Pilot's 2 s deadline.
